records.action_taken: Assign qmcharge=0 for catalytic site with Mg2+
records.diagnosed_cause: Catalytic site contains Mg2+ (+2) coordinating His119, Asn160, Gln139, scissile phosphate (-1). Initial assumption of neutral QM region resulted in unpaired electron count.
records.corrective_action: Increment qmcharge from 0 to +1 to satisfy closed-shell singlet ground state for semi-empirical Hamiltonian.
records.learned_rule: In I-PpoI endonuclease, catalytic Mg2+ coordination requires total qmcharge=+1 to maintain closed-shell singlet state and avoid spin contamination.

records.action_taken: Select active site pocket within 4.0 Angstroms of erlotinib AQ4
records.learned_rule: Met769 backbone NH provides indispensable hinge hydrogen bond (2.8 A); Thr766 interacts via bridging crystal water which should be excluded in dehydrated models.

records.action_taken: Include DFG motif Asp381 and Gatekeeper Thr315 in QM region
records.learned_rule: Imatinib stabilizes the DFG-out inactive conformation in ABL kinase; Thr315 OG1 forms crucial hydrogen bond with aminopyrimidine ring.
